limitations: The fixture is small, fixed, adversarial, synthetic metadata; it is not an accuracy estimate or user outcome study.
The qrels matrix is synthetic judgment and is reported as written; labels are not independently verified.
The opened local-comparison grammar remains characterization-only and is excluded from aggregate acceptance.
A recall packet exposes final context only, so candidate-pool/admission losses and ranking-stage causal effects are unobservable.
Synthetic event timestamps and minimum foreground duration are protocol values, not observed browsing behavior.
RSS/latency are from this host and short-lived CLI process, not reference-device acceptance.

method.candidate_generation_admission_ranking_l: not exposed by the supported recall packet; no stage attribution inferred
method.characterization_handling: local-comparison characterization query is reported separately and excluded from the acceptance aggregate until contract support is explicit
method.group_definition: hostname + title; native records imported as visits with no search query
method.native_partial_status: A returned partial packet is preserved as a native result (including warnings/index state); only process/protocol/packet-mapping exceptions are runner failures.
method.qrels_pass: All 15 queries, including expected-empty and characterization, run against metadata-only vaults with no feedback sidecar.
method.scenario_vault_protocol: each scenario gets a separate disposable clone; ordered feedback is replayed only through the native feedback operation

export_note: Machine-local paths omitted; metrics, fixture IDs, packets and labels retained.
group_metric_caveat: Runner group keys preserve hostname plus title. Its attainable denominator applies policy, six slots and two per site; it does not account for native cross-site payload collapse. Supplemental fresh native payload scores are in native-payload-groups.json.
